_comment: Formulaic phrases replaced in the built HTML, the way data/blocked-claims.json
phrases are.
WHY A PASS AND NOT A GENERATOR EDIT
The generators were fixed at source. These are the same phrases sitting in the
layer no generator owns: the pages baked by the retired tools/generate_scale_v3.py
— the home page, /faq/, /konfigurator/, /studio/, /nachhaltigkeit/, /redaktion/
and the 7,400 location pages. Editing those pages by hand would break the rule
that content lives in a generator or a data file, so the rule they live under
is this file.
HOW THE LIST WAS CHOSEN
By counting, not by taste. tools/score-prose-style.mjs was run over the pages
in the sitemap and ranked every filler construction by how many pages carry it.
'professionell' came first at 101 occurrences on 52 pages, 'projektbezogen'
second at 91 on 40. Each entry below is one of those, with the compound
replaced by the thing it was standing in for — who decides, or what it depends
on.
WHAT IS NOT IN HERE, DELIBERATELY
Hedges. 'grundsätzlich', 'in der Regel', 'in eng begrenzten Fällen',
'unverbindlich' and their translations are counted separately by the scorer and
left alone. They are the reason a statement on this site survives being quoted;
removing them would not make the site warmer, it would make it wrong. Measured
before and after this pass: 1,051 hedges, then 1,053. Nothing was softened.
Longest phrase first, so a longer phrase is replaced before a shorter one that
is a substring of it. Re-running finds nothing, which keeps the pipeline
idempotent.
